name: Averill Quint (5-6)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

defensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
defensiveAbilities.description: Averill devours his raw fish and regains 4d6 healing Hit Points.

defensiveAbilities.name: Grave Tidings
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement A grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, or unconscious creature is within Averill's reach

Effect Averill whispers into the creature's ears, compelling them to join him. The creature is unable to attack Averill Quint for the duration, unless Averill uses a hostile action against them, and any undead Pathfinder can treat the creature as an ally for purposes of flanking. The creature must attempt a DC 24 Will save

Critical Success The creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The curse lasts 1 round.

Critical Failure The curse lasts 2 rounds.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Stench
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet DC 21 Fortitude save

A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save or recovers from being sickened is temporarily immune to all stench auras for 1 minute.

defensiveAbilities.name: Swift Stroke
defensiveAbilities.description: Averill swims up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Averill's Orders
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round;

Effect Averill orders an ally to attack or to get in position. The ally can immediately Strike or move up to half its swim Speed. If it moves, the movement does not trigger reactions.
